summary: Preserved candidate PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2709 at 2d936043ec8b8908941ba527ddfc82310fa08c9a and corrected the two concrete grpc.health.v1 Watch defects reproduced by independent review PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2775. Watch now publishes only requested-service status changes, returns SERVICE_UNKNOWN without terminating for an unregistered service, and observes later registration. This remains a verified implementation of only the standard-health portion of the umbrella issue.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction against a release rebuild of exact candidate 2d936043: unchanged NOT_SERVING was emitted twice and unknown Watch terminated with NOT_FOUND. Raw output is in failing-before.txt.
All 16 Rust tests passed, including unchanged-update suppression and SERVICE_UNKNOWN-to-SERVING observation after late registration.
Rebuilt the corrected optimized native extension at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-bb18b2ea2556/fixed-target/release/libsglang_grpc_core.so.
All sglang-grpc targets passed clippy with warnings denied.

Live grpcio compatibility/regression coverage against the rebuilt native library: 7 tests and 2 subtests passed, covering Check, Watch transitions, unknown Watch, duplicate suppression, and bridge compatibility.
Passing-after adversarial evidence: no unchanged event arrived within 1.8 seconds and unknown Watch returned SERVICE_UNKNOWN while remaining open. Raw output is in passing-after.txt.

gpu_evidence: No GPU execution was appropriate: the corrected code is the CPU-side gRPC health control plane and has no numerical output. No model or architecture claim is made.
remaining_limitations: Native gRPC multimodal image, audio, and video inputs remain unimplemented and unverified, including aggregated and encoder-disaggregated coverage.
RL operations and explicit pause/drain, weight-update, ready-to-serve, and resume lifecycle semantics remain unimplemented and unverified.
No model weights, model server, multimodal architecture, encoder-disaggregated deployment, RL workload, distributed workload, or GPU numerical path was exercised.
The deterministic live RuntimeHandle validates transport and health-state behavior only; it does not qualify inference correctness or any model architecture.
Rust 1.92.0, rustfmt, and clippy were installed under the private job runtime; the pinned Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2 stack were not changed.
